event_time_shape_check.name: event_time_shape_check
event_time_shape_check.value:
("event"."all_day" and "event"."start_date" is not null and "event"."end_date" is not null
            and "event"."starts_at" is null and "event"."ends_at" is null and "event"."time_zone" is null)
       or (not "event"."all_day" and "event"."starts_at" is not null and "event"."ends_at" is not null
            and "event"."time_zone" is not null and "event"."start_date" is null and "event"."end_date" is null)

event_time_order_check.name: event_time_order_check
event_time_order_check.value:
("event"."ends_at" is null or "event"."ends_at" >= "event"."starts_at")
       and ("event"."end_date" is null or "event"."end_date" > "event"."start_date")

event_synced_check.name: event_synced_check
event_synced_check.value: "event"."source" <> 'synced' or ("event"."calendar_source_id" is not null and "event"."external_uid" is not null)

task_scheduled_window_check.name: task_scheduled_window_check
task_scheduled_window_check.value:
("task"."scheduled_starts_at" is null) = ("task"."scheduled_ends_at" is null)
       and ("task"."scheduled_ends_at" is null or "task"."scheduled_ends_at" > "task"."scheduled_starts_at")

message_author_check.name: message_author_check
message_author_check.value:
("message"."role" = 'kev' and "message"."tier" is not null and "message"."model" is not null)
       or ("message"."role" = 'user' and "message"."tier" is null and "message"."model" is null)

proposal_status_shape_check.name: proposal_status_shape_check
proposal_status_shape_check.value:
case "proposal"."status"
        when 'pending' then "proposal"."decided_by" is null and "proposal"."decided_at" is null and "proposal"."decided_channel" is null
          and "proposal"."result_ref" is null and "proposal"."failure_reason" is null
        when 'expired' then "proposal"."decided_by" is null and "proposal"."decided_at" is null and "proposal"."decided_channel" is null
          and "proposal"."result_ref" is null and "proposal"."failure_reason" is null
        when 'approved' then "proposal"."decided_by" is not null and "proposal"."decided_at" is not null and "proposal"."decided_channel" is not null
          and "proposal"."result_ref" is not null and "proposal"."failure_reason" is null
        when 'rejected' then "proposal"."decided_by" is not null and "proposal"."decided_at" is not null and "proposal"."decided_channel" is not null
          and "proposal"."result_ref" is null and "proposal"."failure_reason" is null
        when 'failed' then "proposal"."decided_by" is not null and "proposal"."decided_at" is not null and "proposal"."decided_channel" is not null
          and "proposal"."result_ref" is null and "proposal"."failure_reason" is not null
        else false end
